maddeler.e:
نغتلم (form VIII)
# نَغْتَلِمُ (naḡtalimu) /naɣ.ta.li.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَلَمَ (iḡtalama)
# نَغْتَلِمَ (naḡtalima) /naɣ.ta.li.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَلَمَ (iḡtalama)
# نَغْتَلِمْ (naḡtalim) /naɣ.ta.lim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِغْتَلَمَ (iḡtalama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
